title: 第九章 室友的震惊
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

坐在旁边的李萌萌起身把张晚柠拉到一旁，扬了扬下巴指了指旁边的陈舟。

“老实交代，这个学弟是怎么回事？”

张晚柠嘿嘿一笑，凑到李萌萌耳边轻声道。

“我男朋友啊。”

李萌萌看了看张晚柠，又看了看那个小学弟，满脸震惊。

“张晚柠，你不是人啊，人小学弟还没开学就给人家拿下了？”

随后李萌萌接着八卦的笑了起来：“怎么样，吃上嘴子了吗？”

我有那么饥渴吗？

张晚柠猛的掐了一下李萌萌腰间的软肉，没好气的说：“想啥呢？这才哪到哪。”

说完，张晚柠摆出一副小女人的样子，补充道：“最起码也得再等几天，人家还很害羞呢！”

“咦～”李萌萌一脸鄙夷的看着张晚柠，“姐妹啊，你是吃上了，别忘了我们啊，咱们学校就是尼姑庵，你可得给力点啊！”

张晚柠尴尬地点了点头，随后把陈舟拉到前面来。

经过刚刚跟张晚柠相处，初见时候的紧张感消失了大半，再加上陈舟本来也不是一个社恐的人，陈舟走上前去，把奶茶放在桌上，大大方方地笑着。

“学姐，这是柠柠给你们带的奶茶。”

旁边的申微见这小学弟这么有礼貌，长得还帅，凑到张晚柠耳边，阴阳怪气了一下，“咦，柠柠，叫得还挺亲的。”

张晚柠朝着陈舟使了个眼神。

陈舟心领神会，因为刚刚柠柠跟他说了，下午的时候她还要在这里迎新，于是他送完奶茶后，就礼貌地告了个别。

“那，柠柠，两位学姐，我先回宿舍了呀！”

两个学姐听着陈舟好听的声音，跟痴女似的，有些春心荡漾，眯着眼睛挥了挥手，目送着学弟离开迎新棚。

“学弟，再见。”

旁边的张晚柠内心鄙视了他们两个一下，靠，这我男朋友！

随后她走到车子旁边，把车开了出来。

“舟舟，上车！”

陈舟跨坐上车，张晚柠轻轻抓着他的手，环在自己的腰间，脸色染起一抹绯红。

柠柠腰间的肉肉很软，像是一个充满了水的气球，可他也不知道为什么，每次碰到柠柠的身体，就止不住得有些气血翻涌。

要小头控制大头了捏！

前面的张晚柠感觉到了陈舟的异样，转过头轻声道：“我们走咯。”

说完，车子开动了，坐在迎新棚下的两个学姐看着俩人亲密的样子，还是有些难以置信。

不是，见一面就这样了？

过几天不得搞出人命啊？

午后的时间，南方天气闷热，校园里的人不多，路上零零星星能看见几个新生，可看到如此美丽的学姐载着一个男生，他们也忍不住为之侧目。

Li Mengmeng, who was sitting next to him, stood up and pulled Zhang Wanning aside, raised his chin and pointed at Chen Zhou next to him.

"Tell me the truth, what's going on with this junior?"

Zhang Wanning chuckled and whispered into Li Mengmeng's ear.

"My boyfriend."

Li Mengmeng looked at Zhang Wanning and then at the elementary school student, her face full of shock.

"Zhang Wan Ning, you are not a human being. You were captured by someone before school started?"

Then Li Mengmeng continued to laugh in a gossipy manner: "How's it going? Did you eat it?"

Am I that horny?

Zhang Wanning pinched the soft flesh of Li Mengmeng's waist fiercely and said angrily: "What are you thinking about? Where are you going?"

After saying that, Zhang Wanning acted like a young woman and added: "At least I have to wait a few more days, I am still very shy!"

"Eh~" Li Mengmeng looked at Zhang Wanning with disdain, "Sister, you've got it, don't forget us, our school is a nunnery, you have to work harder!"

Zhang Wanning nodded awkwardly, and then pulled Chen Zhou forward.

After getting along with Zhang Wanning, most of the nervousness when they first met disappeared. In addition, Chen Zhou was not a socially anxious person. Chen Zhou stepped forward, put the milk tea on the table, and smiled openly.

"Senior sister, this is the milk tea Ning Ning brought for you."

Shen Wei, who was standing next to him, saw that this junior boy was so polite and handsome, so he leaned into Zhang Wan Ning's ear and said with a strange expression, "Hey, Ning Ning, you sound so cute."

Zhang Wanning glanced at Chen Zhou.

Chen Zhou understood, because Ningning had just told him that she would be here to welcome the new couple in the afternoon, so after he delivered the milk tea, he politely said goodbye.

"Well, Ning Ning, you two seniors, I'm going back to the dormitory first!"

Listening to Chen Zhou's pleasant voice, the two seniors looked like idiots, feeling a little excited, squinting their eyes and waving their hands, watching the juniors leave the orientation shed.

"Junior, goodbye."

Zhang Wanning next to her felt contempt for the two of them, Damn, this is my boyfriend!

Then she walked to the car and drove out.

"Zhouzhou, get in the car!"

Chen Zhou got into the car, Zhang Wanning gently grabbed his hand and put it around his waist, with a blush on his face.

The flesh around Ning Ning's waist was very soft, like a balloon filled with water, but he didn't know why, but every time he touched Ning Ning's body, he couldn't help but feel the blood surge.

It’s up to the small head to control the big head!

Zhang Wanning in front felt something strange about Chen Zhou, turned around and whispered softly: "Let's go."

After saying that, the car started to move. The two senior sisters sitting under the orientation tent were still a little unbelievable when they saw the two of them being so intimate.

No, that's it after just meeting each other?

How many days will it take to kill someone?

In the afternoon, the weather in the south was sultry and there were not many people on campus. A few freshmen could be seen here and there on the road, but when they saw such a beautiful senior carrying a boy, they couldn't help but look at her.
